newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait dismisses Iraq zone pledge.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait dismisses Iraq zone pledge.

text.p: Kuwait on Saturday dismissed as an unacceptable tactical retreat Iraq's pledge not to violate no-fly zones in southern and northern Iraq.
"This is an unacceptable way now," Information Minister Sheikh Saud Nasser al-Saud al-Sabah told reporters.
It was Kuwait's first official reaction to Baghdad's promise on Friday not to attack Western aircraft patrolling the air exclusion zones.
"He found a line of retreat and retreated. (Iraqi President) Saddam Hussein is now trying to retreat from his position concerning the no-fly zones," Sheikh Saud said.
"Neither logic, the mind nor any politican in the world can deal with Saddam Hussein in this fashion."
U.S.-led Western air forces in Turkey and the Gulf bar flights by Iraqi aircraft north of the 36th parallel and south of the 33rd parallel.
Iraq's ruling Revolutionary Command Council said it had decided "to suspend our military reaction (until further notice) to the parallel lines" as of midnight (2000 GMT) on Friday.
